title: Pelvis, Hip and Femur: Binding, Rapid Transport and Hidden Bleeding

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already bind pelvises, pad hips on the stretcher and apply traction splints. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Read a pelvic injury, bind it by the BC rules, plan for hidden bleeding
  2. Tell a hip fracture from a hip dislocation; follow the BC hip protocol
  3. Manage the big dislocations; spot complications that come later

Textbook: Chapter 28, PDF pages 2362–2400
slides.say: Welcome back. Today we move to the injuries that threaten life or limb: the pelvis, the hip and femur, and the major dislocations. As EMRs you've already bound pelvises and padded hips on stretchers, so we'll add the PCP layer. When does a pelvic fracture become a shock patient who needs fluid and TXA? How do you tell a hip fracture from a hip dislocation, and why does BC call every hip dislocation rapid transport? And which complications can show up after the splint is on?
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。今天讲威胁生命或肢体的损伤：骨盆、髋和股骨，以及几种重要的脱位。作为 EMR，你们已经绑过骨盆、在担架上给髋部垫过衬垫，所以今天加上 PCP 这一层。骨盆骨折什么时候变成需要补液和 TXA 的休克病人？怎么区分髋部骨折和髋关节脱位？为什么 BC 把所有髋关节脱位都列为快速转运？还有，哪些并发症会在上好夹板之后才出现？

slides.title: The pelvis: a ring that bleeds
slides.body:
• Fewer than 3% of fractures, but a major killer in blunt trauma
  • Death rate 8–50%; over 50% if open or with vessel injury
  • Bleeding mostly from pelvic veins; can exceed 3 L
Side impactlateral compressionring smaller; other injuries
Open bookfront-to-back forcering opens; big bleed
Vertical shearfall onto the feetleg shortened; big bleed
slides.say: The pelvis is a ring of bone surrounded by blood vessels. Pelvic fractures are fewer than three percent of all fractures, yet they're a major cause of death in blunt trauma. Mortality ranges from eight to fifty percent, and goes above fifty percent when the fracture is open or a vessel is torn. Most of the bleeding comes from pelvic veins, and it can be more than three litres. A side impact squeezes the ring smaller, so a massive bleed is less common, but other injuries are likely. A front-to-back force opens the ring like a book, and the bigger space fills with blood. A fall onto the feet can shear one side upward, shortening the leg, with a big bleed.
slides.sayZh: 骨盆是一个被血管包围的骨环。骨盆骨折不到全部骨折的百分之三，却是钝性创伤的重要死因。死亡率在百分之八到五十之间，开放性骨折或合并血管撕裂时超过百分之五十。出血大多来自盆腔静脉，可以超过三升。侧方撞击把骨环挤小，大出血较少见，但常合并其他部位的伤。前后方向的力把骨环像书一样打开，变大的空间会被血填满。双脚着地的坠落可以把一侧骨盆剪切向上移，伤侧腿变短，出血也大。

slides.title: Binding the pelvis in BC
slides.body:
Major mechanism suggesting pelvic fracture, plus any one:

  • HR > 100 or systolic < 90
  • Pelvic pain or instability on exam
  • Decreased LOC, or a major distracting injury
  • Not for neck-of-femur (hip) fractures or simple falls from standing
  • Commercial binder, or 3 overlapping broad triangular bandages
  • Centre on the greater trochanters; no zap straps; don't roll
slides.say: Now the BC binding rules. Bind the pelvis when the mechanism suggests a pelvic fracture, plus any one of these: a heart rate over one hundred or a systolic under ninety, pelvic pain or instability on exam, a decreased level of consciousness, or a major injury distracting from the exam. Don't bind a hip fracture, meaning a broken neck of the femur, or a simple fall from standing height. Use a commercial binder or three overlapping broad triangular bandages, centred on the greater trochanters, tight enough to support but not to cause pain. No zap straps, and don't roll the patient. When you examine, press the iliac wings inward once. If the pelvis moves, never test it again; each push can restart bleeding.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲 BC 的骨盆固定规则。受伤机制提示骨盆骨折，再加上以下任意一条，就要固定骨盆：心率超过一百或收缩压低于九十；检查时骨盆疼痛或不稳；意识水平下降；或有分散注意力、妨碍骨盆检查的重大损伤。髋部骨折，也就是股骨颈骨折，以及站立高度的简单跌倒，不要固定。用商用骨盆带，或三条互相重叠的宽三角巾，中心对准股骨大转子，松紧以能支撑、不引起疼痛为准。不能用扎带，也不要给病人翻身。检查时向内按压髂翼一次；骨盆一旦有活动，就绝不再查，每按一次都可能让出血重新开始。

slides.q: An 81-year-old woman tripped on a rug at home. Her right leg is shortened and turned outward, and her hip hurts. Vital signs are normal. What is the best plan?
options: Apply a pelvic binder centred on the greater trochanters
Support the leg as found with blankets and pillows, give analgesia, recheck distal pulses
Apply a traction splint to pull the leg back to length
Straighten the leg quickly so she fits on the stretcher
slides.say: Let's check. An eighty-one-year-old woman tripped on a rug at home. Her right leg is shortened and turned outward, and her hip hurts. Her vital signs are normal. What is the best plan? A, apply a pelvic binder centred on the greater trochanters. B, support the leg as found with blankets and pillows, give analgesia, and recheck distal pulses. C, apply a traction splint to pull the leg back to length. D, straighten the leg quickly so she fits on the stretcher. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来检查一下。一位八十一岁的女士在家被地毯绊倒，右腿变短、向外旋，髋部疼痛，生命体征正常。最好的方案是什么？A 上骨盆带，中心对准股骨大转子；B 用毯子和枕头按发现时的位置支撑患肢，给镇痛药，复查远端脉搏；C 上牵引夹板把腿拉回原长；D 迅速把腿拉直，好放上担架。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. A shortened, outward-turned leg after a simple fall points to a hip fracture, which is supported in the position found. A is wrong: BC lists both hip fractures and falls from standing as reasons not to bind. C is wrong: BC uses the traction splint for mid-shaft femur fractures, not hip injuries. D adds pain and can cause more damage.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。简单跌倒后腿变短、外旋，提示髋部骨折，应按发现时的位置支撑固定。A 错：BC 把髋部骨折和站立高度跌倒都列为不固定骨盆的情形。C 错：BC 的牵引夹板用于股骨中段骨折，不用于髋部伤。D 会加重疼痛，还可能造成更多损伤。

slides.title: Hip fracture or hip dislocation?
slides.body:
InjuryLeg positionTypical cause
Hip fracture (displaced)shortened, turned outolder adult, simple fall
Posterior dislocation (> 90%)flexed, turned in, toward midline, shortenedknee hits the dashboard
Anterior dislocationflexed, turned out, away from midlineforced spreading, hip flexed

Posterior: check the sciatic nerve. Anterior: femoral artery and nerve. Both: the femoral head can lose its blood supply.
slides.say: The leg position often tells you which injury you're facing. A displaced hip fracture, usually in an older person after a simple fall, gives a shortened leg that rolls outward. If it isn't displaced, the leg can look normal, so trust the pain and the inability to bear weight. A hip dislocation needs high energy. More than ninety percent are posterior, typically a knee hitting the dashboard: the leg is flexed, turned inward, pulled toward the midline, and shortened. Check foot movement and feeling, because the sciatic nerve is at risk. An anterior dislocation leaves the leg flexed, turned outward and pulled away from the midline, and can injure the femoral artery and nerve.
slides.sayZh: 腿的姿势常常告诉你是哪种伤。移位的髋部骨折，多见于老人简单跌倒，腿变短、向外旋；如果没有移位，腿可能看起来正常，所以要相信疼痛和不能负重这两点。髋关节脱位需要高能量。超过百分之九十是后脱位，典型是膝盖撞仪表盘：腿屈曲、内旋、向中线内收、变短。要查足部的运动和感觉，因为坐骨神经有危险。前脱位时腿屈曲、外旋、向外展开，可能伤到股动脉和股神经。

slides.title: The BC hip protocol
slides.body:
Every hip dislocation = Rapid Transport

  • Dislocation + nerve or vessel damage = limb-threatening
  • Isolated hip fracture: rapid transport if nerve or vessel damage
  • Support with helpers, rolled blankets and ties
  • Firm, blanketed stretcher or spinal device; stop all hip motion
  • Secondary survey en route; recheck pulses and nerves; pain relief
  • Hip slips back in? Update the receiving hospital
slides.say: Here's the BC Hip Dislocation and Fracture protocol, and its headline is simple: every hip dislocation is in the rapid transport category. With nerve or vessel damage it's also limb-threatening, and early reduction in hospital is essential to avoid long-term damage. An isolated hip fracture becomes rapid transport if there's nerve or vessel damage. At every licence level, support the limb with helpers, rolled blankets and ties, move the patient onto a firm, blanketed stretcher or spinal device, and secure them so the hip can't move. Finish the secondary survey en route, recheck vitals, pulses and nerve function, and manage pain. If the hip slips back in on the way, update the hospital.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 的髋关节脱位/骨折流程，核心很简单：所有髋关节脱位都属于快速转运类别。合并神经或血管损伤时，它还是威胁肢体的损伤，及早在医院复位对避免长期后遗症至关重要。单纯髋部骨折如果有神经或血管损伤，也要快速转运。各级别都这样做：靠帮手、卷起的毯子和绑带支撑患肢，把病人移到铺好毯子的硬担架或脊柱固定器材上，固定好，让髋部完全不能动。剩下的二次评估在途中完成，复查生命体征、脉搏和神经功能，做好镇痛。如果途中髋关节自己复位了，要通知接收医院。

slides.title: Femur shaft fractures
slides.body:
• High energy → hunt for other injuries
  • Thigh can hold 500–1,500 mL (book table: 1,000–1,500)
  • Severe pain, spasm, shortening; may be open
  • Risks: nerve and vessel injury, fat embolism
  • Stable → traction splint (BC STAPLES)
  • Unstable → don't splint piece by piece: package and go
slides.say: A broken femur shaft takes a lot of force, so it should make you hunt for other injuries. The thigh can hold a lot of blood: the book gives five hundred to fifteen hundred millilitres in one place, and one to one and a half litres in its table. Either way, it can push a patient toward shock. Expect severe pain, muscle spasm, and a shortened or angulated thigh. These fractures also risk nerve and vessel injury and fat embolism. BC uses the traction splint for a mid-shaft femur fracture in a stable patient. If the patient is unstable, don't spend scene time splinting each fracture; secure them to the stretcher, go, and treat shock en route.
slides.sayZh: 股骨干骨折需要很大的力，所以要主动寻找其他损伤。大腿能积很多血：书里一处写五百到一千五百毫升，表格里写一到一点五升，不管哪个，都可能把病人推向休克。会有剧痛、肌肉痉挛、大腿缩短或成角。这类骨折还有神经血管损伤和脂肪栓塞的风险。BC 的牵引夹板用于稳定病人的股骨中段骨折。病人不稳定时，别在现场花时间一处处上夹板，把病人固定在担架上就走，途中处理休克。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: pelvis, hip and femur
slides.body:
BC Pelvis binding, Hip, Traction Splint and Hypovolemia protocols

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Bind the pelvis before transport, if indicated
  • Hip: support as found, secure, rapid transport
  • Traction splint: stable mid-shaft femur
  • Supine, warm, O₂ to SpO₂ ≥ 94%
  • Analgesia in stable, appropriate patients

PCP adds (en route or if delayed)

  • IV access
  • Fluid bolus 20 mL/kg, max 2 L; reassess every 500 mL
  • Consider TXA 2 g IV over 1 min for shock from bleeding
  • TXA: not after 3 h, not under 12
slides.say: Let's put the BC protocols side by side. On the left is what every licence level does: bind the pelvis before transport when the criteria are met, support and secure the hip and transport fast, splint a stable mid-shaft femur with traction, and give pain relief to stable, appropriate patients. On the right is the PCP layer from the hypovolemia protocol, done en route or during a delay. Start an IV and give twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred. And consider TXA, two grams IV over one minute, for shock from blood loss or hidden bleeding, within three hours of injury, in patients twelve or older.
slides.sayZh: 把 BC 的几个流程放在一起看。左栏是各级别都做的：符合标准时在转运前固定骨盆；支撑、固定髋部并快速转运；稳定的股骨中段骨折上牵引夹板；对稳定、合适的病人镇痛。右栏是 PCP 从低血容量流程多出来的一层，在转运途中或有延误时做：开静脉，按每公斤二十毫升补液、最多两升，每五百毫升复评；对失血或隐匿出血导致的休克，考虑 TXA，两克静脉推注、一分钟推完，限受伤三小时内、十二岁及以上的病人。

slides.q: A motorcyclist crashed 40 minutes ago. His pelvis moved when you pressed the iliac wings. HR 126, BP 82/50. Transport is 30 minutes. You are the PCP. What is the best plan?
options: Bind the pelvis and go; en route, IV 20 mL/kg up to 2 L, reassess every 500 mL, consider TXA
Start an IV and run 2 L on scene before binding the pelvis
Recheck pelvic stability at every reassessment to track the injury
Avoid TXA, because a pelvic fracture is a contraindication
slides.say: A motorcyclist crashed forty minutes ago. His pelvis moved when you pressed the iliac wings. His heart rate is one hundred twenty-six and his blood pressure is eighty-two over fifty. Transport is thirty minutes. You're the PCP. What's the best plan? A, bind the pelvis and go; en route, start an IV, give twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassess every five hundred, and consider TXA. B, start an IV and run two litres on scene before binding the pelvis. C, recheck pelvic stability at every reassessment to track the injury. D, avoid TXA, because a pelvic fracture is a contraindication. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 一位摩托车手四十分钟前出了车祸，你按压髂翼时骨盆有活动。心率一百二十六，血压八十二比五十，转运时间三十分钟。你是 PCP，最好的方案是什么？A 固定骨盆后出发，途中开静脉，按每公斤二十毫升补液、最多两升，每五百毫升复评，并考虑 TXA；B 先在现场开静脉输两升，再固定骨盆；C 每次复评都重新检查骨盆稳定性，以追踪伤情；D 不给 TXA，因为骨盆骨折是禁忌。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is A. He meets the BC binding criteria: a major mechanism, an unstable pelvis, a heart rate over one hundred and a systolic under ninety. Bind before transport; the PCP's IV, fluid and TXA happen en route. He's an adult within three hours of injury, so TXA fits. B delays transport and leaves the pelvis unbound. C is harmful: once the pelvis is unstable, don't test it again. D is false: TXA's contraindications are allergy, more than three hours, age under twelve, and isolated head injury.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 A。他符合 BC 的骨盆固定标准：重大受伤机制、骨盆不稳、心率超过一百、收缩压低于九十。转运前固定，PCP 的静脉通路、补液和 TXA 在途中做。他是成人，受伤不到三小时，适合用 TXA。B 拖延转运，而且骨盆没固定；C 有害，骨盆一旦确认不稳就不要再查；D 是错的，TXA 的禁忌是过敏、受伤超过三小时、不满十二岁和单纯颅脑外伤。

slides.title: Big dislocations: knee, elbow, shoulder
slides.body:
JointMain dangerClue
Kneepopliteal artery, leg nervesoften pops back in, looks normal
Elbowbrachial artery, median and ulnar nervesmostly posterior
Shoulderaxillary nerve (deltoid skin)about 90% anterior

Pulse present → splint as found. Pulseless → BC: one realignment attempt (book: medical direction before reducing a knee). Still pulseless → unstable.
slides.say: Three dislocations deserve respect. The knee is a true limb-threatening emergency, because the popliteal artery behind it can tear. Many knee dislocations pop back in by themselves, so a normal-looking knee after a big twist or crash still needs frequent pulse checks. The elbow usually dislocates backward, and can injure the brachial artery and the median and ulnar nerves. About ninety percent of shoulder dislocations are anterior; check the skin over the deltoid for the axillary nerve. If there's a pulse, splint the joint as found. If the limb is pulseless, BC allows one realignment attempt, while the book asks for medical direction before reducing a knee. Still pulseless? Manage the patient as unstable.
slides.sayZh: 有三种脱位要格外重视。膝关节脱位是真正威胁肢体的急症，因为膝后的腘动脉可能撕裂。很多膝脱位会自己复位，所以大幅扭伤或车祸后膝盖看起来正常，也要经常查脉搏。肘关节通常向后脱位，可能伤到肱动脉以及正中神经和尺神经。约百分之九十的肩关节脱位是前脱位，要查三角肌表面皮肤的感觉，评估腋神经。有脉搏，就按发现时的位置固定关节。肢体无脉时，BC 允许尝试一次复位对线，而书里要求复位膝关节前先请示医疗指导。仍然无脉？按不稳定病人处理。

slides.title: Complications that come later
slides.body:
ComplicationCluesYour care
Compartment syndromepain out of proportion, worse on passive stretch; pulse may be presentloosen splints, heart level only, cold, go
Fat embolism12–72 h after long-bone or pelvic fracture: breathless, confused, petechiae, feveroxygen, support, transport
DVT / PEswollen leg; sudden breathlessness, chest pain on breathingoxygen; massive PE: no big boluses
slides.say: Some complications appear after your splint is on, or even days later. Compartment syndrome is swelling trapped inside tight muscle walls. The first clue is pain out of proportion to the injury, worse when you passively stretch the muscle, and a pulse doesn't rule it out. Loosen tight splints, raise the limb only to heart level, apply cold and transport; only surgery fixes it. Fat embolism happens when fat from the marrow enters the blood, usually twelve to seventy-two hours after a long-bone or pelvic fracture: breathlessness, confusion, tiny skin spots called petechiae, and fever. Long immobilization can cause a leg clot that travels to the lung. And if it's a massive pulmonary embolism, the book warns against large fluid boluses.
slides.sayZh: 有些并发症在上好夹板之后，甚至几天后才出现。骨筋膜室综合征是肿胀被困在紧绷的肌肉筋膜里。最早的线索是疼痛与伤情不成比例，被动牵拉肌肉时更痛，而且有脉搏也不能排除。松开过紧的夹板，肢体只抬到心脏水平，冷敷，然后转运，只有手术能解决。脂肪栓塞是骨髓里的脂肪进入血液，通常在长骨或骨盆骨折后十二到七十二小时出现：气短、意识混乱、皮肤上细小的出血点（瘀点）和发热。长时间制动可以形成下肢血栓并流到肺部。如果是大面积肺栓塞，书里提醒不要大量推注补液。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Pelvis: test it once; bind before transport
  • Fluid: reassess every 500 mL; aim for perfusion, not high BP
  • TXA: 2 g IV over 1 minute; faster can drop the BP
  • TXA stops: > 3 h since injury, age < 12, isolated head injury
  • Traction on: never release it; recheck with every move
  • Hip slips back in en route? Update the hospital
slides.say: Now the PCP watch-outs for today. With a pelvis, test once, bind before transport, and don't keep checking it. With fluid, reassess every five hundred millilitres; the book aims for good perfusion while avoiding high blood pressure, because a higher pressure can push off clots that are holding. TXA is two grams IV, pushed over one full minute; pushing faster can drop the blood pressure further. Its hard stops are more than three hours since injury, age under twelve, and an isolated head injury. Once a traction splint is on, never release it, and recheck the traction with every move and every set of vitals. And if a dislocated hip slips back in, tell the hospital.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲今天 PCP 要注意的事。骨盆只查一次，转运前固定，不要反复检查。补液每五百毫升复评一次；书里的目标是保证灌注、同时避免血压过高，因为血压一高，可能把正在止血的血块冲掉。TXA 是两克静脉推注，要推满一分钟，推太快会让血压进一步下降。它的硬禁忌是受伤超过三小时、不满十二岁和单纯颅脑外伤。牵引夹板一旦上了就绝不能松开，每次搬动、每次测生命体征都要复查牵引。还有，脱位的髋关节如果自己复位了，要告诉医院。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Hip dislocation: book splints as found → BC adds: always Rapid Transport
  • Binder: commercial, or 3 broad triangular bandages; no zap straps
  • No binder for hip fractures or simple falls from standing
  • Book: 1–2 large-bore IVs → BC: IV is PCP only, en route or if delayed
  • Book's opioids and sedatives for reductions: not in BC EMR/PCP scope
slides.say: Here's where the book and BC differ. For a hip dislocation, the book asks for a full trauma assessment and a splint in the position found. BC adds a firm rule: every hip dislocation is rapid transport. The book binds the pelvis with a binder or a sheet; BC names a commercial binder or three overlapping broad triangular bandages, never zap straps, and no binder for hip fractures or simple falls from standing. The book places one or two large-bore IVs for a pelvic fracture; in BC, IV access is PCP-only, en route or during a delay. And the book's opioids and sedatives for reducing joints are not in BC EMR or PCP scope.
slides.sayZh: 看看书和 BC 的区别。髋关节脱位，书里要求全面创伤评估、按发现时的位置固定；BC 再加一条硬规定：所有髋关节脱位都快速转运。书里用骨盆带或床单固定骨盆；BC 指定商用骨盆带或三条重叠的宽三角巾，绝不用扎带，而且髋部骨折和站立高度的简单跌倒不固定骨盆。书里骨盆骨折要开一到两条大号静脉；在 BC，静脉通路只有 PCP 能做，在途中或有延误时做。还有，书里复位关节时用的阿片类和镇静药，不在 BC EMR/PCP 范围内。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Bind by BC criteria (not hip fractures, simple falls); test once
  2. Every hip dislocation is Rapid Transport: support as found
  3. Shock: IV en route, 20 mL/kg up to 2 L, TXA 2 g over 1 min within 3 h

Next: Chapter 29, Respiratory Emergencies
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: bind the pelvis by the BC criteria, a major mechanism plus any one sign, but not for a hip fracture or a simple fall from standing, and test the pelvis only once. Two: every hip dislocation is rapid transport; support it as found, recheck nerves and pulses, and update the hospital if it slips back in. Three: when these fractures cause shock, the PCP adds an IV en route, fluid at twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, and TXA, two grams over one minute, within three hours. Next, Chapter 29, respiratory emergencies. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 记住三件事。一，按 BC 标准固定骨盆：重大受伤机制加任意一条征象；髋部骨折和站立高度的简单跌倒不固定；骨盆只查一次。二，所有髋关节脱位都快速转运：按发现时的位置支撑，复查神经和脉搏，途中复位了要通知医院。三，这些骨折导致休克时，PCP 在途中开静脉，按每公斤二十毫升补液、最多两升，并在三小时内给 TXA 两克、一分钟推完。下节课是第 29 章，呼吸系统急症。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
